description: K3-E Opportunity Evidence Vector slot registry — the executable family-mapping receipt. Every construct a vector slot may carry is enumerated here with its canonical owner, read seam, clock bindings (K1 clock classes over unrenamed owner-native fields), object class, and fusion-family binding. Every slot maps to exactly one of: an existing governed conditional-fusion family member, research_only, or candidate_new_family (which routes to K5 / Eval OS and gains no authority here). The registry composes over owners; it never re-homes a column: where this file and research/prophet_fusion/families.yml disagree on a column's family home, families.yml governs and this file is defective.

fusion_family_registry.law: THAT file is the law for family membership (one column, one family; masterplan prose is its view). K3-E binds constructs to (family, member) pairs that must exist there verbatim; tests assert the join.

unowned_axes.company_impairment_attribution: NO OWNER EXISTS. DRL (engine/price_pressure/, the Dislocation & Recovery Lobe) owns residual-shock harvest plus the filing-coverage family only; zero impairment constructs exist in its code or masterplan (C0 §4.1 ruling 2, re-receipted 2026-08-25: grep -rin impair over the DRL masterplan and engine/price_pressure/*.py exits 1). Any slot claiming an impairment attribution is unknown-construct-invalid until an owner is minted by its own commission.
unowned_axes.latent_net_demand: NEVER OBSERVABLE (E0 observability matrix). Residual price is not demand. No construct may claim it; never emit net_demand = f(price, residual, volume).

forbidden_input_columns.law: engine/us_prophet_fusion.py FORBIDDEN_INPUTS — composite/score outputs that may never be read as evidence by any slot.

t0_sources.law: Decision-time authentication pins (Sol REQUEST_CHANGES 2026-08-25 item 1, 2026-08-26 item A; semantic K3E_R021). Every vector's asof.t0_evidence_ref is checked against its t0_source row here: t0_mode must be a member of lawful_t0_modes, owner_store must equal the pin (when non-null), recorded_clock.clock_class must equal the pin (when non-null), digest_required sources must carry native_digest state 'known', and in t0_mode 'live' the recorded clock may not postdate t0 by more than max_recording_lag_days — a decision-time object minted after the fact fails closed. t0_mode 'retrospective_research' replaces the lag law with the visible declaration; every other authentication check still binds. ASSURANCE LAW (Sol 2026-08-26 item A): 'live' is a claim of OPERATIONAL point-in-time, and this contract may only permit it where validation itself can check the pointer — i.e. where owner_store and recorded_clock_class are pinned here. The generic source authenticates nothing at validation time, so lawful_t0_modes excludes 'live' for it. A source with no lawful_t0_modes key may claim only 'retrospective_research': a missing pin never grants the stronger claim.

notes: winner_case.v1 files. A pre-registered t0 hypothesis may be recorded BEFORE its t0 (prospective registration): negative lag is lawful and is the good case.

DRL ledger event rows (engine.price_pressure.ledger.read_ledger); the minting clock is the ledger's own harvested_asof, classed observed exactly as the drl_resid_shock slot clocks class it — one native field never carries two classes on this wire.
The generic source: any owner-backed PIT object, carrying a MANDATORY immutability receipt (native_digest state 'known') plus a known minting clock and a declared owner_store.

HONEST BOUNDARY (red-team 2026-08-25, correcting an earlier overclaim). This row does NOT prove the referenced object exists or that the digest is its true hash: with owner_store and recorded_clock_class unpinned, both are caller-declared. What it changes versus the retired caller_named_pit_object free string is (a) the reference is structurally decomposed into K1 EvidenceRef fields instead of one opaque label, (b) a specific 64-hex digest must be committed to, so the claim is falsifiable by anyone who fetches the object, and (c) the minting clock is mandatory, so the retrospective-t0 fence applies. It is an ACCOUNTABILITY receipt, not a verification. A t0 that must be verifiable at validation time belongs on one of the four pinned owner sources above, which do bind owner_store and clock class.

ASSURANCE CEILING (Sol REQUEST_CHANGES 2026-08-26 item A). The boundary above is now enforced instead of merely disclosed: because this source is an accountability receipt and not a validation-time verification, it MAY NOT claim t0_mode 'live'. lawful_t0_modes is ['retrospective_research'] and K3E_R021 fails a generic+live vector closed. Rationale: 'live' asserts operational point-in-time, and every input that would substantiate it here — the store, the minting clock class, the bytes behind the digest — is caller-declared, so a live claim on this source would be the caller vouching for the caller. The four pinned sources above may claim 'live' because validation checks their owner_store and clock class against these pins.

max_recording_lag_days is null BY CONSTRUCTION, not by omission: the lag budget is only ever consulted in 'live' mode, which this source cannot enter. The null is also a second, independent fence — a future wave that re-opens 'live' here by widening lawful_t0_modes alone still fails closed on the missing budget (the K3E_R021 MINOR-11 path), so re-opening requires deliberately minting a budget rather than editing one list.

Consequence a future wave may close: verifying a digest requires reading the owner's bytes, which this contract cannot do — it is a pure in-memory view with no owner imports and no I/O. Binding this source harder means either pinning more owner stores here or giving the validator an owner-read seam, and the latter is a producer decision outside this contract's authority. Until one of those lands, no artifact in this contract may describe the generic path as fully authenticated.

dislocation.law: The lawful dislocation decomposition (E0_DISLOCATION_RESEARCH_SPEC §2.1, ruled lawful by C0 §4.1 ruling 1) emits named per-term components only and may never be reconstituted into one scalar: no construct, field, or value may fuse, weight, or sum these terms into a single dislocation number, and ret_raw — the observed identity total — is never re-emitted under another name. Missing terms are omitted with typed states, never 0. peer_basis disclosure is mandatory on every residual term (basis_required).
dislocation.owner_status: UNPRODUCED for windowed multi-term attribution — the statistical parts exist (DRL event-day residual; residual_alpha 12-1) but no owner assembles the 5-layer windowed pack (E0 census #6: NOT ASSEMBLED). Slots in this group therefore carry typed missingness in v1 unless a term is readable from an existing owner (event-day resid/resid_z via drl_resid_shock). Building the producer is NOT authorized by this contract.

DNR:KILL-LIQUIDITY-SHOCK-REVERSAL-CLASSIFIER — closed at OHLCV grade; do not re-propose by re-tuning z/volume/horizon/peer-basis/label taxonomy; its analyst-revision firewall reopener is coverage-blocked-not-null and stays accruing
DNR:KILL-PARALLEL-SHOCK-CLASSIFIER — the statistical layer stays numeric; no named day types
DNR:KILL-FUSED-COMPOSITE — no reconstituted scalar in any scored path

residual_alpha_momentum.title: Medium-horizon sector-neutral residual momentum (12-1), within-sector rank context
notes: NOT interchangeable with drl_resid_shock — two different residualizations (E0 dislocation spec §2.1).
Context only: did not clear BH-FDR/DSR on the modern era; never a standalone alpha score.

drl_resid_shock.title: DRL event-day residual shock vs peer basis (reactive, cross-sectional)
notes: Residual values (resid, resid_z, peer_ret, peer_basis) are read from the DRL ledger, never re-derived; do not fork sigma.
peer_basis=market is disclosed and never passed off as sector-idiosyncratic (latest panel: sector 52.79% / market 47.21%).
DRL authority is all-false display; DNR:KILL-LIQUIDITY-SHOCK-REVERSAL-CLASSIFIER binds (including its retune clause).

drl_filing_coverage.title: DRL filing-coverage family for the event (earnings-filing | other-filing | no-filing | filing-coverage-unknown)
notes: This filing-COVERAGE family is what DRL actually owns on this axis (engine/price_pressure/context.py FAMILIES). It is not an impairment verdict; the impairment axis is unowned (see unowned_axes).

drl_event_state.title: DRL event resolution state (per-side lifecycle + terminal windows)
notes: An instrument verdict is not a market verdict: a terminal window state means the declared windows resolved, never that a thesis is true or false.

state_updated is a market SESSION date derived from bar indices (engine/price_pressure/ledger.py grading walk), i.e. the owner's evaluation/build clock — belief_or_build, not a system write clock (repaired from system_recorded on red-team finding, 2026-08-25).

macro_chain_state.title: Macro chain / tripwire instrument state touching the subject's theme (display tier)
notes: Dual-read law (operator 2026-08-09, gold/real-rate case): when this instrument state disagrees with the terminal asset's tape, the tape-side observed slots lead the read and this state is the footnote. A chain FAILED can never set any market_reflection leg.

estimate_revisions.title: Analyst estimate revisions snapshot (EPS trend/revisions, coverage)
estimate_revisions.reader: owner parquet read at asof <= t0
notes: Pre-2026-06-16 is not_available_for_date (unlicensed_absent consensus history) — never backfilled, never zero.
n_covering nulls stay null (HARD HONESTY: never substitute reviser count).

prospective_expectation_src_a1.title: SRC-A1 prospective raw EPS/revenue expectation observation + attempt receipt (append-only accrual)
notes: OPTIONAL evidence family only: the vector is valid and complete-able without it; its absence is typed not_available_for_date, and it is never a prerequisite for composition.

coverage_count.title: Analyst coverage count (n_covering) — coverage, not quality
notes: NEGLECTED is not yet a data state (E0 Q6): missing attention/coverage makes lifecycle UNRESOLVED, never NEGLECTED.

short_interest.title: FINRA short interest (biweekly settlement)
short_interest.artifact: data/finra/short_interest_panel.parquet (PIT panel carrying knowable_date) + data/finra/short_interest.parquet (capture store; its asof/capture_date is a capture clock, observed class, never knowable)
notes: knowable_date is the estate's ONE canonical FINRA availability clock — the 8th NYSE session after settlement (lib/finra_knowable.py; engine/short_pressure.py PIT LAW: joins on knowable_date, never settlement_date). The capture store's asof (= collector run date, collectors/finra.py) is an observed-class capture clock and is NOT knowable — pinning it as known_at was the exact owner-clock-collapse this registry exists to kill (repaired on red-team finding, 2026-08-25).
A knowable_date describing a two-week-old settlement is stale for the current tape and must be typed stale — collapsing settlement and availability clocks is the named mutation kill.
Days-to-cover uses FINRA ADV, not borrow; utilization/CTB/locate are UNKNOWN constructs and stay out of this registry.

smart_money_13f.title: Curated 13F holdings state (quarterly, +45d lag)
notes: A 13F increase known only after t0+45d cannot explain a t0 entry: inclusion requires known_at (acceptance/public date) <= t0, never report_period <= t0 — the look-ahead mutation kill.
WA-R2 / NEXTL-U13: ownership is context / crowding hazard, never a positive opportunity input.

options_state.title: Options surface state (IV/skew observed; GEX/dealer gamma modeled)
notes: GEX / dealer gamma is modeled, a different state than observed — the slot state must be modeled, never observed.
Before 2026-06-15 the construct is not_available_for_date, never 0. Signed initiator flow is forbidden without trade-level NBBO.
Options intelligence productization is owned by AD-1 (#5872) — cite, do not fork.

turnover_liquidity.title: Turnover / dollar-volume liquidity state
notes: Float-based share turnover is a Track-C gap — not in this registry; do not infer it from volume-vs-history.

theme_membership.title: Theme/basket membership state at t0
notes: A theme term in the dislocation decomposition exists only when membership exists at t0 (E0 dislocation spec §5.4).

attention_views.title: Attention dimension (views / log views)
notes: No durable pre-2026 PIT attention tape exists; historical absence is not_available_for_date.

forensics_scalars.title: Fundamental forensics scalar state (display-only projection)
notes: Canadian/FPI names may have zero EDGAR rows: missing filings are not missing operations — the state is not_applicable or not_available_for_date, never an impairment claim.

capital_structure_supply.title: Capital-structure / dilution event-candidate state (form-level, backlogged parser)
notes: Backlog honesty: no event in projection is not a clean cap table — absence with a pending parser backlog is coverage partial, never a clean verdict. Do not read 424B2 count as dilution intensity.
Capital Structure Intelligence V2 (#5901) owns this axis's architecture — cite, do not fork.

Join key: dilution_events.parquet natively carries BOTH cik and ticker columns, so a listing-symbol subject joins owner-native same-key on ticker (cross_owner_join false). Any cik-keyed instrument object without a native ticker requires the Earnings company_identity.v1 PIT alias and types identity_unresolved without it.

etf_flow_shares_outstanding.title: ETF shares-outstanding flow proxy (creations/redemptions)
notes: An ETF-flow slot's state derives from OBSERVED VARIATION in the artifact, defaulting stale, never from the field's nominal meaning (C0 §4.1 ruling 5; SPY so_mn measured constant across five weeks while NAV moved).
No governed flow family exists for creations/redemptions; as a signal candidate this routes through K5 / Eval OS and gains no authority here.

prophet_entry_signal.title: Prophet entry/actionability status (entry_signal.status) — owner read
prophet_entry_signal.owner: engine/entry_signal.py (assess) — the entry/actionability axis; projected by engine/prophet_board_read.py
prophet_entry_signal.artifact: prophet.board_read/v1 status field (owner-native entry_signal.status, produced by engine.entry_signal.assess inside scripts/build_stock_library.py; published verbatim, unmapped words included)
notes: THE canonical live actionability surface for the entry_availability.entry_signal leg (Sol REQUEST_CHANGES 2026-08-25 item 3 — this closes the former Track-C open question by naming the owner). The status word is the owner's own vocabulary, projected verbatim; this vector never buckets, ranks, or re-derives it.

When the owner surface has no record for the subject (not a Prophet plan / not in the stock library) the slot is typed missing/unknown per the owner's own disclosure — never inferred from board admission, and never no-entry-state.
entry_role slots never enter the observed/inferred/market_reflection legs; this construct may only ever be referenced by entry_availability.entry_signal.

prophet_board_lane.title: Prophet board admission state (lane / buyable / eligible) — admission/context owner read
prophet_board_lane.artifact: data/us_prophet_rank/candidates/ frame columns lane, buyable, eligible
notes: ADMISSION/CONTEXT ONLY (Sol REQUEST_CHANGES 2026-08-25 item 3): lane / buyable / eligible are Prophet board admission state and may NOT satisfy the entry_availability leg — the actionability surface is prophet_entry_signal (engine.entry_signal.status). An admission_context slot may be carried as typed context but may never be referenced from ANY projection leg (semantic K3E_R011).

Prophet's admission verdict is not vector evidence: never enters observed/inferred/market_reflection (red-team repair 2026-08-25). Prophet selection/gating is untouchable; Prophet does not consume this vector.

radar_probe_admission.title: Live Entry Radar probe admission / eligibility / freshness — owner read
notes: PROBE/COVERAGE STATE, NEVER A TRADE-ENTRY VERDICT (Sol REQUEST_CHANGES 2026-08-25 item 3): this construct answers 'is Radar watching this name', and feeds ONLY the entry_availability.radar_probe_coverage leg, whose verdict_class pins that reading on the wire. entry_role slots never enter the observed/inferred/market_reflection legs (red-team repair 2026-08-25).

ProbeRecord carries no score, rank, points, candidate boolean, or bullish field — admission is a coverage decision, not an opinion; this vector projects it verbatim under DEC:PROPHET-LAB-B5A-RECUT's read/filter/join/decorate-only verbs.

Radar neither consumes nor writes this vector. Radar W5 forward tables are score-search-contaminated for any weight fitting (DNR:KILL-OUTCOME-AUDITION; PR-0 §18 A2.5 side-door law) — no vector construct may be fit, tuned, or selected on them.
